title: Continuous-section realization of norm-continuous representations
statement: Let $F$ be a normed field and $P$ a topological group. Use the existing all-continuous coefficient ring $C_F$ [def-sfb-norm-continuous-monodromy-data] and internal action modules [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. For a topological $F$-vector space $V$ with continuous addition and scalar multiplication and an $F$-linear representation $\rho$ of $P$, a continuous-section realization is an internal action module $M$ equipped, for every profinite $S$, with additive section identifications $M(S)\cong C(S,V)$, intertwining pointwise $C(S,F)$-scalar multiplication, precomposition restrictions and $g\cdot v(s)=\rho(g(s))v(s)$ for every $g\in C(S,P)$. Every jointly continuous action has a realization. A continuous equivariant linear map determines the unique morphism acting by postcomposition on these sections. Restricting the group action leaves the section realization unchanged. Bundle the same coefficient ring as a commutative ring object, and bundle the existing postcomposition coefficient morphism [def-sfb-continuous-map-condensed-ring-map]. For its normalized scalar-action restriction [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data], a continuous equivariant semilinear additive map likewise determines the unique action-module morphism with its pointwise section formula. These section descriptions use the existing internal-module/section-module equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. For finite-dimensional scalar-extended representations, use the actual tensor-product module with its finite-dimensional module topology and the tensor-extended action. The fixed subspace is the existing ordinary invariant subspace with its induced residual action. Define its scalar-extended inclusion, restriction of equivariant maps to that subspace, and coefficient insertion from $E\otimes_E V$ to $F\otimes_E V$ by the actual tensor maps. These maps intertwine the actions and their inclusion square commutes.
